limitations: Fraction token 4-12 / 4+12 (deposited 412) assigned to fraction 1 (lowest pH) by position; its composition is not described in the paper
ActDON (16 h) files are absent from the deposited MaxQuant search; label direction rests on the paper Methods only, and ON=16 h is inferred from the file name
PADI4 doxycycline duration for the MS samples not stated (sampling time not available)
PADI4-inducible HEK293T annotated as parental HEK293T (CVCL_0063); no Cellosaurus entry confirmed for the derivative
Supplementary files (Fig. S1C, S4C SILAC set-ups) were not accessible (PMC proof-of-work gate); SILAC directions verified from deposited quantification instead
Collision energy 25 NCE from instrument method file names, not scan headers
3 of 44 RAW header range reads returned no data (instrument verified on 41)
No ontology term for anti-MMA peptide immunoenrichment; characteristics[enrichment process] omitted
sdrf-tools reconcile reported 2 BLOCKERs (Trypsin not in PRIDE protocol; label-free vs SILAC) judged false positives against paper Methods and MaxQuant summary.txt

The label-swapped 3 h experiment (files ..._ActD3hrs_rev...) is named `ActD2hr` in the deposited MaxQuant experiment design. The SDRF uses 3 hour: the paper has no 2 h time point and the file names say 3 hrs; its methyl-site ratios are anti-correlated with the forward ActD experiments, confirming light = ActD.
